_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.src: I challenge you to reach the final floor!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.src: Have you got what it takes to conquer it?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.dst: Хватит ли у тебя сил покорить её?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.src: Perhaps you would like to know the layout of the tower first? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.dst: Может, сперва хочешь узнать, как устроена башня? Хе-хе-хе-хе...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.src: There are {~} floors in this tower, each with ten levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.dst: В этой башне {~} этажей, на каждом по десять уровней.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.src: Each floor has nine regular levels and one boss level.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.dst: На каждом этаже девять обычных уровней и один уровень босса.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.src: To pass a regular level, you must collect five tokens from the challenge on that level, and one token from boss levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.dst: Для обычного уровня собери в испытании пять жетонов, для уровня босса - один.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.src: After you beat a whole floor, you will return here and you can begin the next one...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.dst: Пройдя весь этаж, ты вернёшься сюда и сможешь начать следующий...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.src: So, what do you say? Hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.src: Turn left and head to the first floor...if you dare...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.dst: Поверни налево и ступай на первый этаж... если осмелишься...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.src: Well done, adventurer, you have successfully completed this floor! You may proceed.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.dst: Отлично, искатель приключений, этаж пройден! Можешь идти дальше.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.speaker: Floormaster

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.src: You have completed my tower, I see...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.src: Did you enjoy Death? Many challengers certainly did. Her power is... unmatched, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.dst: Понравилась ли тебе Death? Многим претендентам очень. Её сила... несравненна, хе-хе-хе...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.src: And you... You are unlike all of them, yes? Few have managed to ascend these floors.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.dst: А ты... Ты из другого теста, да? Немногим удалось подняться по этим этажам.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.src: A tower of madness, fueled by Death herself... Quite a challenge, yes?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.dst: Башня безумия, питаемая самой Death... Непростое испытание, да?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.src: You have joined us now, champion... Few can claim this victory as their own. Fewer still have held their mind.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.dst: Теперь ты с нами, чемпион... Немногие могут назвать эту победу своей. Ещё меньше сохранили рассудок.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.src: For this honor... A reward, for you. You have truly earned it... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.dst: За эту честь... Награда для тебя. Она по праву твоя... Хе-хе-хе-хе...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.src: I need five tokens from the enemies in this room as evidence that you are strong enough to ascend.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.dst: Мне нужно пять жетонов с врагов этой комнаты - доказательство, что ты достаточно силён, чтобы подняться.
